book.the_emerald_standard.handbook.gloss: GLOSSARY: MONEY

Inventory E: items.
Bank Cash: spendable.
Savings: safe interest.
Net Worth: account value,
not items or gifts.
Principal: start sum.
GLOSSARY: RATES I

Interest: balance growth.
Annual rate: 365-day standard.
Term: committed days.
Maturity: term end.
CD: fixed-rate deposit.
GLOSSARY: RATES II

Yield: stated lending return.
Default: repayment loss.
Recovery rate: principal share returned after a partial default.
GLOSSARY: MARKET I

Asset: investment.
Share or Holding: owned part.
Ticker: short code.
Index: asset basket.
Commodity: trade good.
GLOSSARY: MARKET II

Quote: current estimate.
Spread: trading cost.
Regime: broad condition.
Volatility: price motion.
GLOSSARY: RESULTS I

Cost basis: remaining purchase cost.
Average price: basis divided by shares.
Allocation: Net Worth share.
GLOSSARY: RESULTS II

Unrealized: result while held.
Realized: result after exit.
Contribution: value in.
Withdrawal: value out.
GLOSSARY: FUND I

Grant: spendable gift.
Endowment: protected village principal.
Payout: released share.
Sponsorship: project gift.
GLOSSARY: FUND II

Treasury: normal funds.
Reserve: emergencies.
Donor title: recognition only; no financial advantage.
GLOSSARY: VILLAGE I

Prosperity: economy.
Safety: stability.
Housing: resident cap.
Output: production.
GLOSSARY: VILLAGE II

Planning: economic work.
Building: visual work.
Backlog: queued blocks.
Lifecycle: settlement condition.
